blocks.zh: 附錄一：資訊/文件查核表 與 附錄二：生物製劑案例研究（前半部）
blocks.en: Appendix 1: Information/Document Checklist and Appendix 2: Biologics Case Study (First Half)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解附錄一查核表如何作為技術轉移初始的知識差距分析工具，並推動風險登錄冊（risk register）的建立
blocks.en: Understand how the Appendix 1 checklist serves as an initial knowledge gap analysis tool for technology transfer and drives the creation of the risk register

blocks.zh: 辨識大分子（生物製劑）與小分子查核表之間的關鍵差異，特別是細胞株、MCB/WCB及可比性協議等要求
blocks.en: Identify the key differences between the large molecule (biologics) and small molecule checklists, particularly requirements for cell lines, MCB/WCB and comparability protocols

blocks.zh: 掌握生物製劑技術轉移的主要挑戰：製程理解度、產品異質性、分析複雜度，以及監管路徑差異
blocks.en: Grasp the main challenges of biologics technology transfer: process understanding, product heterogeneity, analytical complexity and differences in regulatory pathways

blocks.zh: 了解CDMO承接生物製劑技術轉移案前，需向客戶索取的「不可或缺文件」清單
blocks.en: Know the list of "non-negotiable documents" a CDMO must request from the client before accepting a biologics technology transfer project

blocks.zh: 理解附錄二案例研究中的風險管理方式：CMO遴選、專案啟動、專案執行三階段的正式與非正式風險管控
blocks.en: Understand the risk management approach in the Appendix 2 case study: formal and informal risk control across three stages (CMO selection, project initiation and project execution)

blocks.zh: 附錄一 (Appendix 1) — 大小分子技術轉移資訊/文件查核表
blocks.en: Appendix 1 - Information/Document Checklist for Large and Small Molecule Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：查核表 = 知識差距分析工具
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Checklist = a Knowledge Gap Analysis Tool

blocks.zh: 附錄一的查核表不只是「收文清單」，更是技術轉移啟動時最重要的差距分析（Gap Analysis）工具。正確使用方式是在技術轉移啟動後立即填寫，為每一項目標記：
blocks.en: The Appendix 1 checklist is more than a "receiving list"; it is the most important gap analysis tool at the start of a technology transfer. The correct way to use it is to complete it immediately after the transfer kicks off, marking each item as:

blocks.zh: Available（已備齊）：文件完整，可直接移交
blocks.en: Available: the document is complete and can be handed over as is

blocks.zh: Partial（部分具備）：文件存在但不完整，需補充
blocks.en: Partial: the document exists but is incomplete and needs to be supplemented

blocks.zh: Missing（缺失）：文件尚未建立，需要重新產生
blocks.en: Missing: the document has not been created and must be generated from scratch

blocks.zh: 這份差距分析的輸出直接驅動風險登錄冊（Risk Register）的建立——「Missing」項目通常就是高風險項目，需要立即分配資源處理。
blocks.en: The output of this gap analysis directly drives the creation of the Risk Register. "Missing" items are usually high-risk items and need resources assigned immediately.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：搬家前的庫存清點
blocks.en: Analogy: The Inventory Check Before Moving House

blocks.zh: 想像你要把一間運轉中的廚房（原廠）搬到另一個地方（接收廠）繼續營業。這張查核表就像是「搬家前的廚房庫存清點表」：鍋子、食譜、食材供應商聯絡方式、健康許可證……每一樣都要逐一確認是否帶走。少了任何一項，新廚房就無法在第一天正常開門。
blocks.en: Imagine moving a working kitchen (the sending site) to a new location (the receiving site) so it can keep operating. This checklist is like a "pre-move kitchen inventory": pots, recipes, contact details for ingredient suppliers, the health permit, and so on. Every item must be checked off one by one as it is taken along. If any one is missing, the new kitchen cannot open normally on day one.

blocks.zh: 大分子（生物製劑）多了「細胞株來源（Cell Bank）」這一行——這就像廚房獨門配方的「酵母菌種」，沒有它，整個生產就無從開始。
blocks.en: Large molecules (biologics) have an extra line, "Cell Bank origin". It is like the yeast culture behind a kitchen's signature recipe: without it, production cannot even begin.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：大分子 vs. 小分子的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Main Differences Between Large and Small Molecules

blocks.zh: 仔細比對查核表，大分子（生物製劑）專屬項目揭示了生物製劑TT的核心複雜性：
blocks.en: Comparing the checklist carefully, the items specific to large molecules (biologics) reveal the core complexity of biologics technology transfer:

blocks.zh: Cell Bank / Origin of Cell Bank：MCB（主要細胞庫）與WCB（工作細胞庫）的特性描述文件，是生物製劑製程的起點
blocks.en: Cell Bank / Origin of Cell Bank: documentation characterizing the MCB (master cell bank) and WCB (working cell bank), which is the starting point of a biologics process

blocks.zh: Control Strategy：大分子列為必要，小分子未標記——因生物製劑的製程複雜度使控制策略成為TT成敗關鍵
blocks.en: Control Strategy: marked as required for large molecules but not for small molecules, because the complexity of biologics processes makes the control strategy decisive for the success of the transfer

blocks.zh: Waste/Vent Characterization：生物製劑廢棄物（含活性生物物質）需特別處理，小分子則無此強制要求
blocks.en: Waste/Vent Characterization: biologics waste (containing active biological material) needs special handling, whereas small molecules have no such mandatory requirement

blocks.zh: 小分子則多了物理化學特性：粒徑（Particle Size）、多形體（Polymorphs）、溶解度（Solubility）、毒理數據（Toxicology）、生體可用率（Bioavailability）——這些是固態製劑和化學合成製程特有的考量。
blocks.en: Small molecules instead have physicochemical properties: particle size, polymorphs, solubility, toxicology and bioavailability. These are considerations specific to solid dosage forms and chemical synthesis processes.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務應用：簽約前必備清單
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Must-Have List Before Contract Signing

blocks.zh: 作為CDMO，在與生物製劑客戶簽署技術轉移協議前，以下文件屬於「不可或缺（Non-negotiable）」：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, before signing a technology transfer agreement with a biologics client, the following documents are "non-negotiable":

blocks.zh: Cell Bank Origin Documentation（細胞株起源文件）
blocks.en: Cell Bank Origin Documentation

blocks.zh: Process Description + CPPs with ranges（含參數範圍的製程描述）
blocks.en: Process Description + CPPs with ranges (process description including parameter ranges)

blocks.zh: Current Specifications & CQAs（現行規格與關鍵品質屬性）
blocks.en: Current Specifications & CQAs

blocks.zh: 至少3批歷史批次數據（Historical Batch Data）
blocks.en: Historical batch data from at least 3 batches

blocks.zh: Stability Data（穩定性數據，至少初步結果）
blocks.en: Stability Data (at least preliminary results)

blocks.zh: 若客戶無法提供上述文件，CDMO應在合約中明確界定「客戶責任（Client Obligation）」並連結時程里程碑，避免因文件缺失造成TT延誤而引發商業糾紛。
blocks.en: If the client cannot provide these documents, the CDMO should clearly define the "Client Obligation" in the contract and link it to timeline milestones, to avoid commercial disputes arising from TT delays caused by missing documents.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若客戶無法提供「Development Run Data」，這對你的工程批（Engineering Run）規劃有何影響？你會如何在風險登錄冊中記錄此差距？
blocks.en: If the client cannot provide "Development Run Data", how does this affect your Engineering Run planning? How would you record this gap in the risk register?

blocks.zh: 「Control Strategy」僅在大分子欄位標記 x，但小分子是否也應有控制策略？查核表的設計邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: "Control Strategy" is marked x only in the large molecule column, but should small molecules also have a control strategy? What is the design logic of the checklist?

blocks.zh: 「Extractable/Leachable/Adsorption Data」在大小分子都標記，但生物製劑為何對此項更敏感？請從產品CQA角度分析。
blocks.en: "Extractable/Leachable/Adsorption Data" is marked for both large and small molecules, but why are biologics more sensitive to this item? Analyze from the perspective of product CQAs.

blocks.zh: 附錄二 (Appendix 2) — 生物製劑案例研究 Section 9.1–9.2：摘要與主要挑戰
blocks.en: Appendix 2 - Biologics Case Study Sections 9.1-9.2: Summary and Key Challenges

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何以mAb為主角？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is the mAb the Lead Example?

blocks.zh: 本附錄選擇單株抗體（mAb）作為主要案例，原因有三：
blocks.en: This appendix chooses the monoclonal antibody (mAb) as its main case, for three reasons:

blocks.zh: 市場主流：mAb佔全球生物製劑市值超過一半，CDMO最常遇到此類品項
blocks.en: Mainstream in the market: mAbs account for more than half of the global biologics market value, and are the product type CDMOs encounter most often

blocks.zh: 平台製程成熟：CHO細胞培養 → 蛋白A親和層析 → 病毒去活化 → 精製層析的平台路徑已建立，CDMO可快速評估接收可行性
blocks.en: Mature platform process: the CHO cell culture → Protein A affinity chromatography → viral inactivation → polishing chromatography platform path is well established, so a CDMO can quickly assess the feasibility of acceptance

blocks.zh: 一次性技術普及：Single-use bioreactor/filtration等技術大幅降低了設備配置差異，減少TT中的設備兼容性風險
blocks.en: Widespread single-use technology: single-use bioreactors, filtration and similar technologies greatly reduce differences in equipment configuration, lowering equipment compatibility risk in TT

blocks.zh: mAb的經驗雖可類推至其他生物製劑，但融合蛋白（fusion proteins）、ADC（抗體藥物結合物）、細胞基因治療（CGT）等分子則有各自獨特的挑戰，不能完全套用。
blocks.en: Although mAb experience can be extrapolated to other biologics, molecules such as fusion proteins, ADCs (antibody-drug conjugates) and cell and gene therapies (CGT) each have their own unique challenges and cannot be handled with the same approach entirely.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「12個月完成第一批GMP批」的含義
blocks.en: Key Point: What "First GMP Batch Within 12 Months" Means

blocks.zh: 文中提到成功TT的基準是「約12個月內完成第一批GMP批次」。這個數字代表從CMO選定到GMP生產完成。對CDMO業務開發而言，這是客戶最常問的問題之一。
blocks.en: The text gives the benchmark for a successful TT as "completing the first GMP batch within about 12 months". This figure runs from CMO selection to completion of GMP manufacture. For CDMO business development, this is one of the questions clients ask most often.

blocks.zh: 影響這12個月的關鍵因素：
blocks.en: Key factors affecting these 12 months:

blocks.zh: 文件完整性（缺文件 = 延誤最大來源）
blocks.en: Document completeness (missing documents are the largest source of delay)

blocks.zh: 長前置期物料（如一次性袋組、層析介質、細胞培養基）的採購時間
blocks.en: Procurement time for long lead time materials (such as single-use bag sets, chromatography media and cell culture media)

blocks.zh: CDMO的製程工程師是否熟悉客戶的平台製程
blocks.en: Whether the CDMO's process engineers are familiar with the client's platform process

blocks.zh: 監管策略（工程批是否需要ICH Q5E可比性研究）
blocks.en: Regulatory strategy (whether the engineering run requires an ICH Q5E comparability study)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：小公司TT困境
blocks.en: Analogy: The Small Company's TT Dilemma

blocks.zh: 小到中型生物技術公司常面臨的情況：臨床前/Phase I期的製程是由學術實驗室或小型CRO完成，批量小（1–10L）、記錄不完整，現在要轉移到2,000L商業規模。
blocks.en: A situation small to mid-sized biotech companies often face: the preclinical/Phase I process was run in an academic lab or a small CRO, at small batch sizes (1-10 L) with incomplete records, and now it must be transferred to 2,000 L commercial scale.

blocks.zh: 這就像一位廚師在家裡用小鍋試驗出一道菜，現在要複製給工廠大量生產——不僅食譜要完整，還要考慮熱傳導、混合效率、原料批次差異……原先在小鍋裡自然成立的條件，大鍋裡可能完全失效。
blocks.en: It is like a cook who developed a dish at home in a small pot and now has to reproduce it for mass production in a factory. Not only must the recipe be complete, but heat transfer, mixing efficiency, ingredient batch variability and more must be considered. Conditions that held naturally in the small pot may fail completely in the big one.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼「gap assessment前置」如此重要：早點發現差距，才能在合約中明確定義誰來填補、費用如何分攤。
blocks.en: This is why "gap assessment up front" matters so much: finding gaps early lets the contract define clearly who will fill them and how the cost will be shared.

blocks.zh: 文中提到「capacity continues to grow」是指需求持續增加。從CDMO角度，產能不足對客戶TT時程有何影響？你會如何在提案階段管理客戶期望？
blocks.en: The text says "capacity continues to grow", meaning demand keeps increasing. From the CDMO's perspective, how does insufficient capacity affect the client's TT timeline? How would you manage client expectations at the proposal stage?

blocks.zh: 「gap assessment prior to initiating the transfer」與「gap assessment during transfer」有何不同？分別在哪個情境下使用？
blocks.en: How does a "gap assessment prior to initiating the transfer" differ from a "gap assessment during transfer"? In which situation is each used?

blocks.zh: Section 9.3 — 技術轉移階段概覽 (Overview of Technology Transfer Phases)
blocks.en: Section 9.3 - Overview of Technology Transfer Phases

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三階段 vs. 六階段框架的調和
blocks.en: Core Concept: Reconciling the Three-Phase and Six-Phase Frameworks

blocks.zh: 本節將ISPE六階段框架（教科書模型）與小型生技公司實際使用的三階段模型（實務模型）對應起來：
blocks.en: This section maps the ISPE six-phase framework (the textbook model) onto the three-phase model (the practical model) that small biotech companies actually use:

blocks.zh: CMO Selection（遴選）→ 先於Phase 1，是外包的前提
blocks.en: CMO Selection → comes before Phase 1 and is the prerequisite for outsourcing

blocks.zh: Project Initiation（啟動）→ 涵蓋Phases 1–3（組隊、知識整合、風險識別）
blocks.en: Project Initiation → covers Phases 1-3 (team formation, knowledge integration, risk identification)

blocks.zh: Project Execution（執行）→ 涵蓋Phases 3–5（OQ、PQ、PPQ）
blocks.en: Project Execution → covers Phases 3-5 (OQ, PQ, PPQ)

blocks.zh: 這種「壓縮框架」在小公司常見，因為沒有足夠的專職TT人員執行完整六階段的儀式性流程。CDMO必須理解客戶可能沒有正式的TT SOP，並主動以自身程序引導流程。
blocks.en: This "compressed framework" is common in small companies because they lack dedicated TT staff to carry out the full ceremony of all six phases. A CDMO must understand that the client may have no formal TT SOP and should proactively guide the process using its own procedures.

blocks.zh: RFP結構框架：CDMO收到的標準投標書
blocks.en: RFP Structure: The Standard Request for Proposal a CDMO Receives

blocks.zh:
RFP架構（客戶發出，CDMO回應）
├── 1. Introduction
│   ├── Background（產品背景）
│   ├── Objectives（目標，如首批GMP日期）
│   └── Response Instructions（回覆規格）
│
├── 2. Scope of Services
│   ├── Technology Transfer（文件接收、製程轉移）
│   ├── Analytical Services（方法轉移、QC建立）
│   ├── Engineering / Clinical Batches
│   ├── PPQ Batches（通常3批）
│   ├── Process Validation
│   ├── Stability（方案設計、樣品存放）
│   └── Additional Services（法規支援、原料採購）
│
└── 3. Supporting Information
    ├── Development Reports
    ├── Batch Records（若有）
    ├── PFDs + Specifications
    ├── Analytical Methods
    └── Bill of Materials
blocks.en:
RFP structure (issued by the client, answered by the CDMO)
├── 1. Introduction
│   ├── Background (product background)
│   ├── Objectives (objectives, such as first GMP batch date)
│   └── Response Instructions (response requirements)
│
├── 2. Scope of Services
│   ├── Technology Transfer (document receipt, process transfer)
│   ├── Analytical Services (method transfer, QC setup)
│   ├── Engineering / Clinical Batches
│   ├── PPQ Batches (usually 3 batches)
│   ├── Process Validation
│   ├── Stability (protocol design, sample storage)
│   └── Additional Services (regulatory support, raw material procurement)
│
└── 3. Supporting Information
    ├── Development Reports
    ├── Batch Records (if available)
    ├── PFDs + Specifications
    ├── Analytical Methods
    └── Bill of Materials

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Stage Gates的作用
blocks.en: Key Point: The Role of Stage Gates

blocks.zh: Stage Gate（階段關卡）是CDMO保護自身和客戶的機制——只有前一個里程碑確認完成，才允許進入下一階段。例如：
blocks.en: A Stage Gate is a mechanism by which the CDMO protects itself and the client: progression to the next stage is allowed only once the previous milestone is confirmed complete. For example:

blocks.zh: 文件傳輸 Gate：文件收齊並審核通過 → 才開始編寫批次記錄
blocks.en: Document transfer gate: documents are fully received and reviewed and approved → only then begin writing batch records

blocks.zh: 方法轉移 Gate：分析方法資格確認 → 才開始工程批
blocks.en: Method transfer gate: analytical method qualification confirmed → only then begin the engineering batch

blocks.zh: 工程批 Gate：製程數據審查通過 → 才進入GMP批
blocks.en: Engineering batch gate: process data review passed → only then proceed to GMP batches

blocks.zh: Stage Gate能早期發現問題，避免在昂貴的GMP批才發現分析方法根本無法用於接收廠設備。
blocks.en: Stage gates catch problems early, avoiding the discovery at an expensive GMP batch that an analytical method simply cannot be used on the receiving site's equipment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：面對面會議為何不可省略？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Face-to-Face Meetings Cannot Be Skipped

blocks.zh: 文中特別強調「Face-to-face meetings are critical」。在視訊會議盛行的時代，這個建議仍然成立，原因是：技術轉移過程中不可避免地會出現問題（偏差、批次失敗、客戶投訴）。
blocks.en: The text specifically stresses that "Face-to-face meetings are critical". Even in the age of video conferencing, this advice still holds, because problems (deviations, batch failures, customer complaints) inevitably arise during technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 這就像急診室的醫護團隊——平常你可以用電話溝通，但在緊急情況下，面對面的默契、信任感與即時決策速度是電話無法取代的。TT啟動會議就是在「真正的危機還沒來之前」，先建立這種信任基礎。
blocks.en: It is like an emergency room team: day to day you can communicate by phone, but in an emergency the rapport, trust and speed of real-time decisions that come from being face to face cannot be replaced by a phone call. The TT kick-off meeting builds that foundation of trust before the real crisis arrives.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務應用：Long Lead Time物料管理
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Managing Long Lead Time Materials

blocks.zh: 「Identification and immediate ordering of long lead time materials/consumables」是執行階段的第二個行動項目，時序上比多數人預期的要早。
blocks.en: "Identification and immediate ordering of long lead time materials/consumables" is the second action item in the execution stage, and it comes earlier in the timeline than most people expect.

blocks.zh: 生物製劑TT中常見的長前置期物料：
blocks.en: Long lead time materials commonly seen in biologics TT:

blocks.zh: 蛋白A層析介質（MabSelect Resin）：前置期6–12週
blocks.en: Protein A chromatography media (MabSelect Resin): lead time 6-12 weeks

blocks.zh: 一次性生物反應器袋組（SU Bioreactor Bag）：8–16週
blocks.en: Single-use bioreactor bag sets (SU Bioreactor Bag): 8-16 weeks

blocks.zh: 細胞培養基（Basal + Feed Media）：如為客製配方可達12週
blocks.en: Cell culture media (Basal + Feed Media): up to 12 weeks if a custom formulation

blocks.zh: 病毒過濾器（Virus Filter）：6–10週
blocks.en: Virus filters: 6-10 weeks

blocks.zh: 若啟動會議後才開始詢價採購，這些物料的到位時間很可能成為工程批的瓶頸。最佳實務是在RFP階段即要求客戶提供BOM，CDMO收到後立即評估哪些屬於長前置期物料。
blocks.en: If sourcing and purchasing start only after the kick-off meeting, the arrival of these materials is likely to become the bottleneck for the engineering batch. Best practice is to ask the client for the BOM at the RFP stage, so the CDMO can assess immediately which items are long lead time materials.

blocks.zh: 若CDMO同時收到6家客戶的RFP，如何快速評估哪些客戶的製程具備轉移可行性？你會看哪三個指標？
blocks.en: If a CDMO receives RFPs from 6 clients at once, how can it quickly assess which clients' processes are feasible to transfer? Which three indicators would you look at?

blocks.zh: 「1–2 cycles of proposal refinement」代表客戶與CDMO在合約前會有多次溝通。從CDMO角度，哪些資訊最容易在第一輪RFP中被遺漏，需要在第二輪補充？
blocks.en: "1-2 cycles of proposal refinement" means the client and CDMO will communicate several times before the contract. From the CDMO's perspective, what information is most easily missed in the first round of the RFP and needs to be added in the second round?

blocks.zh: Section 9.4 — 風險管理 (Risk Management)
blocks.en: Section 9.4 - Risk Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念：生物製劑TT的風險管理現實
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Reality of Risk Management in Biologics TT

blocks.zh: 本節揭示了一個重要的實務真相：小型生技公司在TT啟動階段通常不做正式風險評估。風險管理的手段主要是：
blocks.en: This section reveals an important practical truth: small biotech companies usually do not perform a formal risk assessment at the start of TT. Their means of managing risk are mainly:

blocks.zh: 非正式層面：SME個人經驗 + due diligence audit（盡職調查審計）
blocks.en: Informal level: individual SME experience + due diligence audit

blocks.zh: 正式層面：在Change Control框架下執行，以及接近PPQ時進行FMEA
blocks.en: Formal level: carried out under the change control framework, and FMEA performed close to PPQ

blocks.zh: 這並不代表這種做法最優，而是小公司資源有限的現實。CDMO應理解客戶可能沒有完整的風險文件，需要主動協助建立。
blocks.en: This does not mean the approach is optimal; it reflects the reality of limited resources in small companies. A CDMO should understand that the client may not have complete risk documentation and should proactively help build it.

blocks.zh: 風險管理時序框架
blocks.en: Risk Management Timeline Framework

blocks.zh:

────────────────────────────────────────

              Site Visit          設施能力確認
              RFP/Proposal        技術可行性評估

合約後啟動    Change Control       正式變更管理
              Kick-off Meeting     風險溝通對齊
              Document Transfer    知識差距確認

工程批/

              Critical Path Plan   時程風險管理

              Process Validation   生產一致性確認
blocks.en:

────────────────────────────────────────

               Site Visit           Confirm facility capability

initiation     Kick-off Meeting     Risk communication alignment
               Document Transfer    Knowledge gap confirmation

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「量化風險評估對小公司效用有限」
blocks.en: Key Point: "Quantitative Risk Assessment Has Limited Utility for Small Companies"

blocks.zh: 文中直白地說：「a quantitative risk assessment for a small company may have limited utility」。這句話值得深思——傳統的ICH Q9 RPN評分（嚴重性 × 發生率 × 可偵測性）在數據不足的情況下，評分本身可能缺乏可信度。
blocks.en: The text says frankly: "a quantitative risk assessment for a small company may have limited utility". This statement deserves reflection: with the traditional ICH Q9 RPN scoring (severity × occurrence × detectability), when data are insufficient the scores themselves may lack credibility.

blocks.zh: 在這種情況下，「有經驗的資深人員的判斷」往往比填滿一份RPN表格更有價值。監管機構對此也有共識：對新分子、新製程，質化風險評估加上專家判斷是被接受的方法。
blocks.en: In such cases, the judgment of experienced senior staff is often more valuable than a fully completed RPN table. Regulators share this view: for new molecules and new processes, qualitative risk assessment combined with expert judgment is an accepted approach.

blocks.zh: 關鍵是：無論用哪種方式，都要有文件記錄——哪怕只是「依據SME判斷，此項目風險可接受，理由如下」也比沒有記錄好。
blocks.en: The key is that, whichever method is used, it must be documented. Even a note such as "Based on SME judgment, the risk of this item is acceptable, for the following reasons" is better than no record.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Critical Path = 登山的關鍵路線
blocks.en: Analogy: The Critical Path = the Key Route up a Mountain

blocks.zh: 「Critical path activities」就是整個TT專案中，如果任何一個延誤，整個專案就無法按時完成的活動鏈。
blocks.en: "Critical path activities" are the chain of activities in the whole TT project where a delay in any one means the entire project cannot finish on time.

blocks.zh: 就像登山隊要在日落前攻頂，必須識別哪條路線上有哪些必須在幾點前通過的節點。如果第一個節點就延誤了，後面再快也無法補回來。
blocks.en: It is like a climbing team that must reach the summit before sunset: it must identify which checkpoints along the route have to be passed by what time. If the first checkpoint is delayed, no amount of speed later can make up for it.

blocks.zh: 在生物製劑TT中，典型的critical path包含：細胞株特性確認 → 長前置期物料到位 → 方法轉移完成 → 工程批執行 → 數據審查 → GMP批。任何一個環節阻塞，第一批GMP批的日期就會直接後移。
blocks.en: In biologics TT, a typical critical path includes: cell line characterization confirmed → long lead time materials on site → method transfer completed → engineering batch executed → data review → GMP batch. If any step is blocked, the date of the first GMP batch moves back directly.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務應用：Weekly Teleconference最佳實務
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Best Practice for the Weekly Teleconference

blocks.zh: 文中提到「weekly teleconferences」作為持續風險管理的機制。有效的每週例行會議結構：
blocks.en: The text mentions "weekly teleconferences" as a mechanism for continuous risk management. An effective weekly meeting is structured as follows:

blocks.zh: Action Item Review（5分鐘）：確認上週行動項目完成狀態
blocks.en: Action Item Review (5 minutes): confirm the completion status of last week's action items

blocks.zh: Critical Path Status（10分鐘）：關鍵路徑活動是否如期進行
blocks.en: Critical Path Status (10 minutes): are critical path activities progressing on schedule

blocks.zh: Issues & Risks（10分鐘）：新出現的問題，責任人和預計解決日期
blocks.en: Issues & Risks (10 minutes): newly arising issues, the responsible person and the expected resolution date

blocks.zh: Next Week Plan（5分鐘）：下週重要里程碑預告
blocks.en: Next Week Plan (5 minutes): preview of important milestones for the coming week

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：PM必須在場（確保follow-up），技術SME之間的討論不應繞過PM直接做決策，所有決策需有會議紀錄存檔以支持未來的查核與調查。
blocks.en: Key principle: the PM must be present (to ensure follow-up), discussions between technical SMEs should not bypass the PM to make decisions directly, and all decisions must be recorded in meeting minutes and filed to support future audits and investigations.

blocks.zh: 文中提到due diligence audit是風險非正式評估的手段之一。若你是客戶的QA代表，due diligence audit的前三大重點檢查項目是什麼？
blocks.en: The text mentions that the due diligence audit is one means of informal risk assessment. If you were the client's QA representative, what would be the top three focus areas of a due diligence audit?

blocks.zh: 「Formal risk assessments are performed as part of change control」——在TT過程中，哪些事件最常觸發正式的變更管理流程？請舉三個例子。
blocks.en: "Formal risk assessments are performed as part of change control": during TT, which events most often trigger the formal change management process? Give three examples.

blocks.zh: 若客戶堅持要CDMO在合約簽署前就完成完整的FMEA，你認為這個要求合理嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the client insists that the CDMO complete a full FMEA before the contract is signed, do you think this request is reasonable? Why?

blocks.zh: Section 9.5 — 技術轉移案例研究概述 (Technology Transfer Case Studies — Overview)
blocks.en: Section 9.5 - Technology Transfer Case Studies - Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：雙視角的學習設計
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Dual-Perspective Learning Design

blocks.zh: ISPE本附錄刻意安排了客戶視角（案例1–2）與CDMO視角（案例3–5）的雙面設計。這並非偶然，而是要讓讀者理解同一個技術轉移事件，在雙方眼中的感受和優先順序可能完全不同：
blocks.en: ISPE deliberately arranged this appendix with two perspectives: the client perspective (Cases 1-2) and the CDMO perspective (Cases 3-5). This is no accident; it helps readers understand that the same technology transfer event may feel completely different, with different priorities, to each party:

blocks.zh: 客戶視角：關注的是時程、成本控制、產品可比性、法規路徑
blocks.en: Client perspective: focuses on timeline, cost control, product comparability and regulatory pathway

blocks.zh: CDMO視角：關注的是製程可行性、設備配置、文件完整性、責任邊界
blocks.en: CDMO perspective: focuses on process feasibility, equipment configuration, document completeness and boundaries of responsibility

blocks.zh: 理解對方的視角是成功TT夥伴關係的基礎。
blocks.en: Understanding the other party's perspective is the foundation of a successful TT partnership.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：本節涵蓋範圍說明
blocks.en: Key Point: Scope of This Section

blocks.zh: 本教學文件（section-06a）涵蓋至Section 9.5的概述性文字（p103結束）。五個個別案例研究的完整內容（9.5.1–9.5.5）收錄於下一個文件（section-06b）。
blocks.en: This tutorial document (section-06a) covers the overview text through Section 9.5 (ending at p103). The full content of the five individual case studies (9.5.1-9.5.5) is in the next document (section-06b).

blocks.zh: 在閱讀具體案例前，建議先鞏固本節的核心框架：查核表差距分析（App.1）、三階段執行模型（9.3）、風險管理時序（9.4）。這些是理解案例的概念基礎。
blocks.en: Before reading the specific cases, it is advisable to consolidate the core frameworks of this section: checklist gap analysis (App. 1), the three-phase execution model (9.3) and the risk management timeline (9.4). These are the conceptual basis for understanding the cases.

blocks.zh: 你認為「客戶視角」與「CDMO視角」在TT過程中最容易產生分歧的時間點是什麼？如何在合約設計上預防這種分歧？
blocks.en: At what point in the TT process are the "client perspective" and the "CDMO perspective" most likely to diverge? How can contract design prevent such divergence?

blocks.zh: 文中強調mAb案例的「lessons learned可適用於所有分子類別」——你認為哪些mAb TT的教訓最不適合直接套用到細胞基因治療（CGT）的TT？
blocks.en: The text stresses that the mAb case's "lessons learned are applicable to all molecule classes". Which mAb TT lessons do you think are least suited to direct application to cell and gene therapy (CGT) TT?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 附錄一查核表是技術轉移啟動時的差距分析工具——為每項標記 Available / Partial / Missing，直接推動Risk Register建立；「Missing」項目即高風險項目
blocks.en: The Appendix 1 checklist is a gap analysis tool at the start of technology transfer: mark each item Available / Partial / Missing, which directly drives creation of the Risk Register; "Missing" items are the high-risk items

blocks.zh: 大小分子差異：生物製劑需額外提供Cell Bank文件、Control Strategy、Waste/Vent特性；小分子需提供粒徑/多形體/溶解度/毒理/生體可用率等物理化學數據
blocks.en: Large vs. small molecule differences: biologics require additional Cell Bank documentation, Control Strategy and Waste/Vent characterization; small molecules require physicochemical data such as particle size/polymorphs/solubility/toxicology/bioavailability

blocks.zh: 三階段實務模型：CMO Selection → Project Initiation → Project Execution，為ISPE六階段框架的小公司適用壓縮版
blocks.en: Three-phase practical model: CMO Selection → Project Initiation → Project Execution, a compressed version of the ISPE six-phase framework suited to small companies

blocks.zh: CMO遴選關鍵：RFP需足夠詳細（含製程細節/規格/BOM），至少進行1–2輪提案精煉，並對前兩名候選人進行due diligence audit
blocks.en: Key to CMO selection: the RFP must be sufficiently detailed (including process details/specifications/BOM), at least 1-2 rounds of proposal refinement should be held, and a due diligence audit should be conducted on the top two candidates

blocks.zh: 風險管理現實：小型生技公司通常以非正式方式（SME經驗+稽核）管理早期風險，FMEA在接近PPQ時才正式引入；定期週例會是持續風險管理的基本機制
blocks.en: Risk management reality: small biotech companies usually manage early risk informally (SME experience + audits), with FMEA formally introduced only near PPQ; regular weekly meetings are the basic mechanism for continuous risk management

blocks.zh: CDMO簽約前必備文件：Cell Bank Origin、Process Description + CPPs、Current Specifications + CQAs、至少3批歷史批次數據、初步穩定性數據
blocks.en: Documents a CDMO needs before contract signing: Cell Bank Origin, Process Description + CPPs, Current Specifications + CQAs, historical batch data from at least 3 batches, preliminary stability data
